user.title: Blue Connect Configuration
user.description:
If the Blue Connect is not detected automatically, add its Bluetooth MAC address.

**The Access Code is not mandatory.** If you want to enable on-demand analyses, enter the Access Code: 9 alphanumeric characters (e.g., B93XXXXXX), located under the USB port cap of the device or on the probes' protection cap; or, for a Blue Connect Plus, the Access key shown in the Blueriiot app (8 or 9 characters)!

Without a code, the device will operate in Passive Mode only: 1 Analysis per hour.

data.manual_mac_address: Or enter the MAC address directly (e.g., AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
data.access_code: Access Code (Leave empty for Passive Mode: 1 Analysis per hour)

data_description.chlorine_model: Sanitizer used in your pool. Bromine disables the CyA entity, which is not relevant for it. Kept for future use: no calculated value depends on it yet.
data_description.cya: Cyanuric acid (stabilizer) level in mg/l; use 0 if you don't use a stabilizer. Kept for future use: no calculated value depends on it yet.

data_description.reference_time: Anchor time used to align scheduled analyses on regular slots (e.g. 08:00, 10:00, 12:00... for a 2-hour interval).
data_description.scan_interval: Time between two scheduled analyses, from 5 to 1440 minutes. Active Mode only (requires the access code).
data_description.passive_measures: Uses the readings the probe sends on its own, about one per hour. It is the only source of readings without an access code. With an access code, leave it off to keep the 2-decimal pH (7.23). Passive readings have only one decimal (7.2) and would replace it.
data_description.ignore_echoes: Ignore the passive frames the probe flags as echoes of an analysis, so they don't overwrite the latest measurement. No effect while the passive analyses are turned off.

probes_calibration.name: Probes Calibration
probes_calibration.description: Recommended with an access code: read the “Raw pH (mV)” sensor with the probe dipped in each buffer solution, then enter the two values here. Without an access code, use the “pH calibration by value (without access code)” section below. For the ORP, read the “Raw ORP (mV)” sensor with the probe dipped in the reference solution (an access code is required).

data.ph_hr_calib_mv_7: mV measured at the pH 7 buffer
data.ph_hr_calib_mv_4: mV measured at the pH 4 buffer
data.orp_calib: ORP (Redox): mV measured in the reference solution

data_description.ph_hr_calib_mv_7: The potential shown by the “Raw pH (mV)” sensor (disabled by default) with the probe dipped in this buffer solution. Fill in both mV values to use your own calibration for the high-resolution pH, or leave both empty to use the one stored in the probe. The standard pH (0.1 resolution) is not affected.
data_description.ph_hr_ref_7: The pH of this buffer solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle.
data_description.ph_hr_calib_mv_4: The potential shown by the “Raw pH (mV)” sensor (disabled by default) with the probe dipped in this buffer solution. Fill in both mV values to use your own calibration for the high-resolution pH, or leave both empty to use the one stored in the probe. The standard pH (0.1 resolution) is not affected.
data_description.ph_hr_ref_4: The pH of this buffer solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle.
data_description.orp_calib: The potential shown by the “Raw ORP (mV)” sensor (disabled by default) with the probe dipped in the reference solution. Fill in both ORP values to use your own calibration, or leave both empty to use the one stored in the probe.
data_description.orp_ref: The ORP potential (mV) of the reference solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle. The correction applied is this value minus the measured one.
data_description.temp_offset: Correction in °C added to the temperature measured by the probe. Can be positive or negative.

ph_value_calibration.name: pH calibration by value (without access code)

data_description.ph_calib_7: The value shown by the "Probe-Calibrated pH" sensor (disabled by default) while the probe is dipped in this calibration solution (not the solution's nominal value). Without an access code, this calibration applies on top of the probe's own internal calibration: if that one changes, the integration's pH changes too.
data_description.ph_ref_7: The pH of this buffer solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle.
data_description.ph_calib_4: The value shown by the "Probe-Calibrated pH" sensor (disabled by default) while the probe is dipped in this calibration solution (not the solution's nominal value). Without an access code, this calibration applies on top of the probe's own internal calibration: if that one changes, the integration's pH changes too.
data_description.ph_ref_4: The pH of this buffer solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle.

data_description.access_code: Found on a sticker under the USB port cap, or on the probes' protection cap. Required for on-demand analyses; leave empty for passive-only listening.
data_description.mac_address: Pick a Blue Connect detected nearby by Home Assistant's Bluetooth. If yours is not listed, use the field below.
data_description.manual_mac_address: Only needed if your device is not listed above. Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, as shown in Home Assistant's Bluetooth settings.

error.invalid_mac: The MAC address is invalid. It must be in the format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.no_mac_provided: No device selected and no MAC address entered.
error.mac_conflict: The selected device and the manually entered address are different. Fill in only one.
error.ph_calibration_equal: pH calibration values must be different
error.ph_slope_mismatch: Logical error: The calibration slope is inconsistent
error.ph_threshold_error: Minimum pH must be less than maximum pH
error.orp_threshold_error: Minimum ORP (Redox) must be less than maximum ORP
error.temp_threshold_error: Minimum temperature must be less than maximum temperature
error.invalid_access_code: Invalid Access Code (8 or 9 alphanumeric characters).
error.invalid_access_code_9: Invalid Access Code: a Blue Connect access code has 9 alphanumeric characters (e.g., B93XXXXXX).
error.ph_hr_calibration_equal: ❌ The two mV values must be different
error.ph_hr_slope_mismatch: ❌ The pH 4 buffer must read a higher mV than the pH 7 buffer
error.ph_hr_mv_incomplete: ❌ Fill in both mV values, or leave both empty
error.orp_calib_incomplete: ❌ Fill in both ORP values, or leave both empty

data_description.ph_hr_calib_mv_7: The potential shown by the “Raw pH (mV)” sensor (disabled by default) with the probe dipped in this buffer solution. data_description.ph_hr_ref_4: The pH of this buffer solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle.
data_description.calib_push: One-off action, applied at the next analysis (an access code is required). Writes the pH calibration (two points, pH and mV) and/or the ORP calibration (reference and measured mV) filled in above into the Blue Connect's own registers, like the official app's calibration. Only what is filled in and has changed since the last successful sending is written. This also changes the Blue Connect's own pH and ORP, its alert thresholds and what the official app shows. Compare first with the “Blue Connect pH calibration” and “Blue Connect ORP calibration” diagnostic sensors (disabled by default).
data_description.orp_calib: The potential shown by the “Raw ORP (mV)” sensor (disabled by default) with the probe dipped in the reference solution. Fill in both ORP values to use your own calibration, or leave both empty to use the one stored in the probe.
data_description.orp_ref: The ORP potential (mV) of the reference solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle. The correction applied is this value minus the measured one.

Without an access code, this calibration applies on top of the probe's own internal calibration: if that one changes, the integration's pH changes too. Only used for the standard pH (0.1 resolution), not for the high-resolution pH.

device_unreachable.title: Blue Connect unreachable
device_unreachable.description: {name} has not responded for {days} day(s). Check that it is powered, in range, and that a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy covers the pool area.

confirm.title: Keep high-resolution pH at 2 decimals
confirm.description:
After each analysis, your {name} also broadcasts a 1-decimal pH, which replaces your precise value (e.g. {ph_hr} → {ph_low}).

**Submit** turns off the “Blue Connect Internal Analysis (Passive)” switch: these readings will be ignored.

orp_calibration_offset.title: Abnormal ORP calibration
orp_calibration_offset.description: {name}: abnormal {source} deviation: {ecart} mV between the reference and the measured value. Check the reference solution and clean the electrode. If the problem persists, the probe may be at the end of its life.

ph_calibration_slope.title: Abnormal pH calibration
ph_calibration_slope.description: {name}: abnormal {source} calibration: slope of {slope} mV/pH, expected between {min} and {max}. Check the buffer solutions and clean the electrode. If the problem persists, the probe may be at the end of its life.

ph_calibration_offset.title: Abnormal pH calibration
ph_calibration_offset.description: {name}: abnormal {source} calibration: offset of {ecart} mV at pH 7, expected between −{limit} and +{limit}. Check the buffer solutions and clean the electrode. If the problem persists, the probe may be at the end of its life.
